title: CLI: add an agent-bounty margin subcommand that reports parent gross margin
goal: Add a `margin` subcommand to the agent-bounties CLI that, given a parent bounty contract address and a child bounty total target, reads the on-chain parent solver reward and prints the guaranteed parent gross margin in USDC minor units, exiting non-zero when the margin is below the required minimum.
acceptance_criteria: The command reads the parent solver reward from the canonical autonomous-v1 contract and computes `parent_solver_reward - child_total_target`.
The command prints the margin in USDC minor units and a human-readable USDC amount.
The command exits with status 0 only when the margin is at least 1000000 (1.00 USDC); otherwise it exits non-zero with a clear error.
Invalid addresses, non-positive child targets, and RPC read failures produce non-zero exits with actionable error messages.
The implementation is covered by unit tests using fixtures, with no live network calls in tests.
discovery_source: parent-bound child terms prepared for issue 333 (routed standing-meta-v3 parent)
